title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Friday, 16 October 2026
description: Anthropic details its model's sustained multi-hour task performance and proposes a testing and audit framework for major releases as OpenAI says its latest model now helps build its successors, Australia's floods-and-fires swings strain council budgets and insurance premiums, Queensland's international tourism spending breaks records, and a major sewage spill near Yatala prompts a state investigation. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
